title.zh: 企業數位轉型與變革管理戰略 (CDO / CIO 商業視角)

slide_title.zh: 技術債危機與數位轉型訴求 (SCQA & DX Mandate)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：競爭對手已透過雲端原生 (Cloud-Native) 架構實現高度敏捷，而我們仍依賴超過 10 年歷史的單體式 (Monolithic) 核心系統
衝突 (Complication)：日益沉重的「技術債 (Technical Debt)」不僅吃掉了 80% 的 IT 維運預算，更導致新產品上市時間 (Time-to-Market) 嚴重落後
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：提議啟動全企業「數位轉型專案 (DX)」，懇請核准核心系統現代化預算，並由 CEO 親自出任變革發起人 (Sponsor)
en: Situation: Competitors are operating on highly agile, Cloud-Native architectures, while we remain tethered to a 10-year-old monolithic legacy core.
Complication: Crippling 'Technical Debt' is consuming 80% of our IT OpEx just to keep the lights on, severely derailing our Time-to-Market capabilities.
The Ask: Activating the enterprise-wide Digital Transformation (DX) initiative. Requesting budget for Core Modernization and mandating the CEO as the ultimate Executive Sponsor.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，我們的 IT 部門現在就像在維修一台邊飛邊漏油的老飛機。我們絕大多數的預算都被『技術債』吃掉了，根本沒有資源做創新。數位轉型不是買幾套新軟體就能解決的，我們必須徹底翻新核心引擎。今天的提案，要求的不只是資金，更要求 CEO 親自跳下來擔任發起人，因為這是一場將動搖既有利益的全面變革。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, our IT organization is currently trying to repair an old airplane while it's in flight. The vast majority of our CapEx is swallowed by 'Technical Debt,' leaving zero runway for innovation. Digital Transformation isn't solved by merely purchasing new SaaS tools; it requires gutting the legacy engine. Today's mandate requests not just funding, but absolute CEO sponsorship, as this transition will aggressively disrupt existing operational silos.

slide_title.zh: 核心系統現代化與雲端戰略 (Core Modernization & Cloud)

zh: 架構重構 (Refactoring vs. Rehosting)：放棄傳統的「原封不動搬上雲端 (Lift-and-Shift)」，改採微服務架構 (Microservices) 進行根本性重構
舊系統退役 (Sunsetting Legacy)：強制訂出舊系統退役的死線 (Hard Deadline)，切斷對舊流程的依賴，釋放高昂的維護授權費
數據中台 (Data Lakehouse)：打破各事業群 (BU) 的數據孤島，建立統一的數據中台，為未來的 AI 決策鋪平道路
en: Refactoring Strategy: Rejecting lazy 'Lift-and-Shift' migrations in favor of aggressively refactoring the core into a Microservices architecture.
Sunsetting Legacy: Enforcing hard deadlines to decommission legacy systems, forcefully cutting dependencies and eliminating exorbitant legacy licensing fees.
Data Lakehouse: Shattering Data Silos across Business Units (BUs) by establishing a unified Data Lakehouse, laying the unshakeable foundation for future AI deployments.

speaker_notes.zh: 在技術路線上，我們絕對不走捷徑。把舊系統原封不動搬上雲端，只是在雲端上製造新的垃圾。我們將採取『微服務架構』重新改寫核心，並強勢切斷舊系統的命脈，逼迫組織前進。同時，我們將打通所有部門的數據孤島，建立數據中台，這是未來我們能全面發揮 AI 戰力的唯一基礎。
speaker_notes.en: Regarding our technical trajectory, we refuse to take shortcuts. 'Lifting and shifting' legacy code to the cloud merely creates garbage in the cloud. We will refactor the core using Microservices and forcefully sunset legacy systems to compel organizational progression. Simultaneously, we are breaking BU data silos to build a unified Data Lakehouse—the singular prerequisite for any future AI capabilities.

slide_title.zh: 變革管理與消弭跨部門阻力 (Change Management & Friction)

zh: 跨部門對齊 (Cross-Functional Alignment)：轉型失敗有 70% 源於「人的抗拒」，必須透過高階溝通與引導，化解新舊部門間的利益衝突
敏捷組織重塑 (Agile Org Restructuring)：將傳統的「瀑布式 (Waterfall)」科層結構，打散重組為以產品為核心的「跨職能敏捷小隊 (Squads)」
重新賦能 (Reskilling & HR Alignment)：聯合 HR 團隊推動大規模的員工技能重塑，將原本負責維護舊系統的員工轉型為雲端架構師或數據分析師
en: Cross-Functional Alignment: Acknowledging that 70% of DX failures are human-centric. Deploying rigorous executive facilitation to neutralize friction and departmental self-interest.
Agile Restructuring: Dismantling hierarchical 'Waterfall' silos and reconstituting teams into cross-functional, product-obsessed Agile Squads.
Reskilling (HR Alignment): Partnering with HR to execute massive reskilling initiatives, transforming legacy maintainers into modern Cloud Architects and Data Analysts.

speaker_notes.zh: 科技只是工具，真正的戰場在『人』。許多資深主管會因為新系統削弱了他們的控制權而暗中杯葛。我們必須透過極高強度的溝通與調解，化解跨部門的防衛心。我們將聯合 HR，把組織打散成敏捷小隊，並提供技能轉型培訓。讓員工知道，數位轉型不是要裁掉他們，而是要幫他們升級。
speaker_notes.en: Technology is merely the tool; the actual battlefield is 'People.' Veteran leaders will covertly sabotage new systems that threaten their fiefdoms. We must deploy intense executive facilitation and mediation to disarm cross-departmental defensiveness. Partnering with HR, we will restructure into Agile squads and launch reskilling programs, proving to our workforce that DX is an upgrade, not a reduction in force.

slide_title.zh: 數位轉型的商業 ROI (Business ROI of DX)
slide_title.en: The Business ROI of Digital Transformation

zh: 營運降本 (OpEx Reduction)：透過自動化與關閉實體機房，預計在第 [X] 年將整體 IT 營運成本 (OpEx) 降低 [X]%
營收驅動 (Top-Line Growth)：敏捷架構將使新產品的開發週期從 6 個月縮短至 2 週，大幅提升市場回應速度與營收轉換率
價值衡量 (Value Realization)：不以「系統上線」為成功指標，而是嚴格追蹤新系統對 EBITDA (稅息折舊及攤銷前利潤) 的實質貢獻
en: OpEx Reduction: Through aggressive automation and decommissioning on-premise data centers, we project a [X]% reduction in IT OpEx by Year [X].
Top-Line Growth: Agile architecture compresses new product development cycles from 6 months to 2 weeks, exponentially accelerating market responsiveness and revenue capture.
Value Realization: Success is not defined by 'System Go-Live.' We measure success strictly by tracking the new system's direct impact on EBITDA.

speaker_notes.zh: 這筆投資不是為 IT 部門買新玩具，而是嚴格的財務決策。在降本方面，關閉實體機房將大幅降低每年的營運費用。在增收方面，我們的新產品開發週期將從幾個月縮短到幾週。我們對董事會的承諾是：不以系統『是否順利上線』來請功，而是拿這套系統到底幫公司多賺了多少 EBITDA 來衡量成敗。
speaker_notes.en: This CapEx is not for IT toys; it is a rigorous financial decision. Regarding cost reduction, decommissioning data centers structurally lowers annual OpEx. On the revenue side, compressing our development cycles from months to weeks directly captures market share. Our promise to the Board: We do not celebrate 'System Go-Live.' We only celebrate the empirical EBITDA generated by this transformation.

slide_title.zh: 18 個月轉型藍圖與決策訴求 (18-Month Roadmap & The Ask)

zh: 第 1-6 個月 (治理與重構)：完成企業架構 (EA) 藍圖設計，設立「數位轉型辦公室 (DTO)」，並啟動首個非核心業務的雲端搬遷試點
第 7-18 個月 (規模化與退役)：將核心交易系統遷移至雲端微服務，強制切斷舊系統連線，並完成全公司 80% 的敏捷組織重塑
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請核准 [X 億] 的數位轉型總預算，並授權 DTO 擁有跨越各事業群的絕對調度與資源分配權
en: Months 1-6 (Governance & Pilot): Finalizing the Enterprise Architecture (EA) blueprint, chartering the Digital Transformation Office (DTO), and executing the first non-core cloud pilot.
Months 7-18 (Scale & Sunset): Migrating core transaction systems to Microservices, forcefully severing legacy connections, and completing 80% of our Agile organizational restructure.
Call to Action: Requesting Board approval for the [$X] total DX budget and granting the DTO absolute, cross-functional authority over resource allocation across all BUs.

speaker_notes.zh: 這是一場耗時 18 個月的心臟手術。前半年我們建立大腦（轉型辦公室 DTO）並進行小規模試點；後一年我們將進入深水區，強制關閉舊系統，重塑整個公司的敏捷文化。為了確保手術成功，我們懇請董事會不僅核准預算，更要賦予 DTO 具備跨越各部門藩籬的『絕對調度權』。我們準備好迎接真正的數位時代了。
speaker_notes.en: This is an 18-month open-heart surgery. The first half-year focuses on building the brain (the DTO) and executing pilots. The subsequent year enters the deep water: forcefully sunsetting the legacy core and mandating an Agile culture shift. To ensure patient survival, I ask the Board not just for capital, but to grant the DTO absolute, cross-functional mandate to override departmental silos. We are ready to execute.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『企業數位轉型與變革管理 (DX)』簡報。受眾為董事會、CEO 或各事業群總經理。內容必須展現 CDO (數位長) / CIO 結合科技與組織行為的高階戰略視角：1. 運用 SCQA 點出『技術債』對商業敏捷性的致命影響，2. 說明捨棄 Lift-and-Shift，改採微服務與強制退役舊系統的技術決心，3. 強烈聚焦於『變革管理 (Change Management)』，探討如何化解跨部門防衛心並推動敏捷組織與技能重塑，4. 運用財務語言證明 DX 能實質降低 OpEx 並驅動 EBITDA，5. 結尾給出 18 個月心臟手術般的轉型藍圖，並要求董事會賦予轉型辦公室 (DTO) 絕對的跨部門調度權。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需充滿打破成規的魄力、變革的同理心與不達目的絕不終止的決心。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Digital Transformation & Change Management (DX)' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors, CEO, or Business Unit GMs. Demonstrate the elite CDO/CIO capability to bridge technology and organizational behavior: 1. Use SCQA to frame how 'Technical Debt' paralyzes commercial agility. 2. Detail the resolve to reject 'Lift-and-Shift' in favor of Microservices and forceful legacy sunsetting. 3. Focus intensely on 'Change Management,' detailing executive facilitation to neutralize cross-departmental friction and mandate Agile reskilling. 4. Speak the CFO's language by proving DX structurally lowers OpEx and drives EBITDA (Value Realization). 5. Conclude with an 18-month roadmap, demanding CapEx and absolute, cross-functional authority for the Digital Transformation Office (DTO). Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project immense transformative resolve, deep empathy for change resistance, and ruthless execution discipline.
